channel.title: The Dig — Software stack: compilers and pulse level
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Software stack: compilers and pulse level preset. Today’s ranked reading list focuses on practical automation and integration for quantum hardware, led by 2611.27140 on FPGA-in-loop autonomous tuning of spin qubits, 2611.27927 on transpilation-aware multi-vendor QPU scheduling, and 2611.29983 on the Cqlib compilation and device-adaptation stack, with 2611.29019 included as a skim for a resource-efficient variational-circuit optimizer demonstrated on hardware.
